text: Appeal of Order to Comply (November 8, 2021) for 15 Swordbill Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (November 8, 2021) for 15 Swordbill Drive, Folder Number 21 233142 PRS 00 IV, and, in doing so, granted an extension of time to June 1, 2022.
